title: Footer: Footer with copyright text (daisyUI)
notes:
Footer can contain logo, copyright notice, and links to other pages.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/footer/+page.md
